topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes on cellular transformation and cancer genetics and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for measuring cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressors, and Mutational Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional definitions, pathway roles, and genetic mechanisms distinguishing oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Forms and Molecular Causes of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how distinct defects in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sequential somatic mutations and inherited germline defects drive and accelerate tumor progression.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer closes the session by summarizing learning outcomes and offering book recommendations.
